title: 5.1 Angles of Triangles

icans: I can classify triangles by their sides and by their angles.
I can use the Triangle Sum Theorem to find angle measures.
I can use the Exterior Angle Theorem to find angle measures.

vocab: a triangle with at least two ____________ sides
an angle formed by one side of a polygon and the ____________ of an adjacent side
a ____________ that can be proved easily using a theorem

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Classifying triangles: by sides: scalene, isosceles, equilateral. By angles: acute, right, obtuse, or _______________ (all angles congruent).
Triangle Sum Theorem: the sum of the measures of the interior angles of a triangle is _______________.

blocks.stem: Two angles of a triangle measure 52° and 71°. Find the third angle.

notes: Exterior Angle Theorem: the measure of an exterior angle equals the _______________ of the measures of the two nonadjacent interior angles.

blocks.stem: Find x and the measure of the exterior angle.

notes: Corollary: the acute angles of a right triangle are _______________.

blocks.stem: The acute angles of a right triangle measure (2x)° and (3x − 5)°. Find both angles.
An exterior angle of a triangle measures 130°. One nonadjacent interior angle measures 72°. Find the other nonadjacent interior angle.

tickets.stem: Two angles of a triangle measure 90° and 25°. Find the third.
The two nonadjacent interior angles measure 48° and 67°. Find the exterior angle.
